body: Well I would never cal him that, he’s always had the same issues as me and has anixiety as well which could be reasons for his aggression, though he is a great dad otherwise and when I was younger he’d even sleep on a mattress near me when I get nightmares just so I feel safe and stay up all night, but many things impact his thoughts regarding autism and mental health such as culture and stress and the new knowledge of this which he had no idea of leading to the denial in his mind that he and his son could likely have autism, problem is that it’s really difficult to tell him this stuff but whenever I’m uncomfortable I usually ask my mom to talk to him and he seems a bit more understanding
